question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

multiple
solution: The correct answer is '**single**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Multiple**' is '**Single**'. • **Multiple**: involving many people or things or having many parts. [बहुल, बहुविध या बहुखंड, (जिसमें अनेक लोग या वस्‍तुएँ शामिल हों या जिसके अनेक अंग खंड हों)] • *Example: **multiple** choice question...* • **Single**: only one. (केवल एक) • *Example: I managed to finish the whole job in a **single** afternoon.* **Correct Answer:__** *Single.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Triple**: having three parts, happening three times or containing three times as much as usual. (त्रिपक्षीय, तिगुना या तिगुने वाला) • **Double**: to become twice as much or as many. (दोगुने या अधिक बनने के लिए) • **Many**: a large number of people or things. (लोगों या वस्‍तुओं की बड़ी संख्‍या, बहुत सारे, अनेक) 3b:T563, The correct answer is **'Change one's opinion'.**
